'''Exchange couplings''' were components set on a [[reactor/Legends|reactor]] of a machinery or [[starship/Legends|starship]].

The reactor of the [[phrikite]] [[Gromas Mines]] on [[Gromas 16]] had a main reactor whose exchange coupling led to the central power grid. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], determined to slow down the [[Dark Trooper/Legends|Dark Trooper]] [[Dark Trooper Project|Project]], sent [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Kyle Katarn]] to [[Mission to Gromas|sabotage]] the installation; placing a [[sequencer charge]] on the coupling, alerted a [[Phase I Dark Trooper|Phase I dark trooper]] who was stationed under the reactor, but it was already too late, as the sabotage resulted to an immense explosion that destroyed all the facility.<ref name="Dark Forces" />

The ''[[Arc Hammer]]'' contained at least three exchange couplings along its power grid. When the ship was [[Mission to the Arc Hammer|infiltrated]] by Katarn, [[Gender/Legends|he]] rigged the three couplings with explosives in an attempt to destroy the starship to end its involvement with the [[Dark Trooper Project]]. The bid was successful, as the destruction of the couplings caused a chain reaction that tore apart the ship.<ref name="Dark Forces">''[[Star Wars: Dark Forces]]''</ref>
